title: Illegal tree felling near Kothri reserve forest
description: Roughly 40 sal trees cleared overnight along the eastern boundary of the reserve, no permit signage visible at the site.

title: Clerk demanding unofficial fee for birth certificate
description: Municipal office clerk asked for ₹500 cash 'processing fee' on top of the official government fee, refused to give a receipt.

title: Fake toll collection point on service road
description: Unauthorized barricade set up by unidentified men collecting ₹50 'toll' from trucks, no official signage or receipt booth.

title: River dumping from textile unit
description: Visible discoloured effluent discharge into the Kshipra tributary during early morning hours, strong chemical smell.
